programme.title: Lenyalo Lethata
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Semakaleng'. We help married couples to recognise conflicts in their marriages, for them to make thoughtful decisions.

programme.desc: 'S3/E10 - Arabile & Onica'. Arabile seeks Nthabiseng's help, discovering betrayal from those closest to her.

programme.desc: 'S9/E13 - There's No Business Like Snow Business'. The buyers head for the mountains and hit high altitude in Rimforest, where they face auctions in the snow!

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E21 - Best Of The Judges'. Join us as we take a look back at the top moments our judges have stepped into the arena to go head-to-head against some of the best smiths in Forged in Fire history.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E1 of 15 - Long Road To Redemption Part 1'. Seven past competitors return to the forge for a second chance at glory and redemption. For the first time ever, they'll have to create four different weapons.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E3 of 15 - General Yamashita's Gunto'. Four bladesmiths are tasked with recreating an iconic fighting knife: the Fairbairn Sykes. Then, two smiths recreate another WWII weapon: General Yamashita's Gunto.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Mysterious Sacred Structures'. England's Stonehenge and the Moai statues of Easter Island have inspired awe for centuries. But will we ever fully understand how and why these structures came to be?

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Mystifying Cursed Objects'. Ancient cultures around the world have aroused fascination, and provoked fear with curses and objects used to conjure them. But is there proof that some might have actually worked?

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - The Bones of St. Peter'. Examines the life of Jesus' lead disciple and the man believed to have been the first Pope. Did he travel to Rome to found the Catholic Church?

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - The Pilate Stone'. Looks at the Roman governor famous for sending Jesus to his death on the cross - Pontius Pilate. Is he depicted accurately in the Bible?

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Raising Lazarus'. Looks at the story of Lazarus and his sisters Mary and Martha, and the relationship they had with Jesus of Nazareth.

programme.title: The Jesus Code
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Doubting Thomas'. This is the story of Thomas, the enigmatic disciple who doubts reports of Jesus' resurrection, but is convinced when he sees the risen Christ.

programme.title: Lost Grail With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Knights Of The Grail'. Professor Alice Roberts continues her Grail quest by unearthing the legendary knights entwined with Britain's sacred past. Her journey explores two powerful threads...

programme.title: Gold Wars Downunder
programme.desc: 'S1/E8'. Donnie and Ronnie have a bust up - threatening Donnie's dream of owning a lease. At the 1870 mine, Richie builds a gold room to sort the super-fine gold from the waste material.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E5 - Hunt For The Crocogator'. In rural Victoria, Mick and Tim finally collect eight neglected classics they paid $1,600 for three years ago but with a 500-kilometre round trip and limited trailer space.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Hidden Giants'. From a legendary city swallowed by the jungle, to an underground metropolis stretching 18 levels deep, sometimes the biggest mysteries on Earth are closer than we think.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E6 - Mysterious Urban Legends'. Urban legends are modern folklore rooted in mystery. From the eerie reports of spontaneous human combustion, to the unsettling boogeymen known as the Men in Black...

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - The South African War'. The Tugela River became the silent witness of one of the greatest humiliations in British military history.

programme.title: Shipwrecks: When History Resurfaces
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - The True Story Of The Pirates Of The Caribbean'. Alongside archaeologists and specialists, Kevin dives into the waters of the Caribbean to discover wrecks of pirates, freebooters and galleons.
